source_review.author_clock: PASS: one checked consecutive timestamp range carries one common local batch counter. Final physical high-water covers the last timestamp before stamping/publication. Imports stay unchanged; native data awaits the single durable coverage barrier.
source_review.complete_metadata_rows: PASS: require_end checks the final distinct union after every physical range proves exhaustion. Stable candidate precedence and paged truncation remain unchanged.
source_review.complete_winner_metadata: PASS: a winning merge adopts its optional metadata and removes the previous metadata. Present KeyMetadata fields are used verbatim, including explicit None; missing whole metadata alone may use intrinsic atom metadata on existing direct/physical paths.
source_review.diagnostic_cli: PASS: the CLI prints the observed reference count or unknown. It prints edge details only when the response provides them; absent enumeration cannot appear as an empty edge set.
source_review.diagnostic_scope: PASS: default owner or internal raw context uses ctx.storage_prefix for every target class. A named database locator is explicitly refused because the target-only route has no schema to resolve catalog aliases. No caller-selected storage prefix or guessed mapping was added.
source_review.logical_wire_counters: PASS: FieldValue, formatted FieldMetadata, and shared query slices omit partial molecule_version counters. Stable molecule identity, selected writer, and intrinsic atom creation time remain.
source_review.native_liveness_diagnostic: PASS: one typed compact reference-count record carries its exactness flag. Missing or inexact counts serialize as active_references=null and complete=false. Exact zero remains distinct. Complete also requires the home-wide v2 read gate; unavailable atom edge details are omitted.
source_review.no_extra_history: PASS: pending prior tips remain private reference effects. Equal atoms create no pending conflict pair or merge conflict. Current tip replacement does not add an atom history chain.
source_review.numeric_order: PASS: signed/unsigned/finite-float comparisons retain exact represented magnitude and transitivity. NaN filter thresholds reject; infinite thresholds retain mathematical order.
source_review.obsolete_diagnostic_removal: PASS: the unused atom_ref_edges_for_atom wrapper and AtomRefEdgeLookup type/export are removed. The explicitly physical legacy-edge helper remains for its current maintenance and reclaim consumers.
source_review.preload_failure: PASS: optional worker preload failure detaches and retires incomplete membership, clears generation/change state, keeps its diagnostic reason, and selects bounded disk reads. Required read failures remain errors.
source_review.same_uuid_current_tip: PASS: newer same-UUID writes replace the complete AtomEntry under the shared strict LWW rule. Equal UUIDs do not create atom conflict records.
source_review.same_uuid_reference_retirement: PASS: accepted import, local, and merge replacements retain every prior full tip for old reverse-reference retirement. This includes equal atoms with different author times. Compact-edge normalization retains any exact final active edge; existence probes prevent false count changes for intermediate edges.
source_review.source_filename_wire: PASS: both owner decoders retain the existing source_file_name field. Shared components, single/prefix templates, and batch constructors carry it into the same validated mutation pipeline.
source_review.strict_zero_clock_rule: PASS: import, merge, pending durable collapse, and durable tip comparison all use the shared strict LWW order. The zero-clock last-write exception and sole helper are absent.
